name: bkl_storm
description: the SMP-H1 BKL storm gate on the PROOF kernel + lean desktop (two 60 s marked-syscall storms, 2 CPUs): both complete with zero corruption, no lock watchdog, whole SMP ladder green. Standalone so it can be re-run alone on a quiet host.
